reconstruction.scope: Individual Glasgow Cathedral: long Gothic nave/choir under pale copper roofs, lower lean-to aisles, crossing transepts, square open belfry and tall tiered faceted stone spire. Great west pointed glazing with circular rose-like tracery above a recessed wood portal, smaller flanking windows, gable oculus/pinnacles, repeated paired clerestory lancets, large aisle windows, east lower-church window band, buttresses and north/south subsidiary ranges. Shared ashlar/limestone/copper/wood. Standard-terrain foundations; no global flattening. Exact stained-glass artwork, stone sculpture/text, restoration scaffolding, graveyard/retaining terraces, trees, full interiors and certified walking excluded.
